Important: We’ve noticed that some players accidentally launch the PC-Desktop version instead of the VR version and then report that VR isn’t working. Please double-check that you're launching the correct version to avoid issues.

You can use Launch Options when you start LoveXLust to launch the intended version. If Launch Options don’t appear, try this:

[list]
[*] Go to your Steam Library
[*] Right-click LoveXLust
[*] Click Properties
[*] In the General tab, find Selected Launch Option and choose "Launch LoveXLust in VR in Steam VR Mode."
[/list]

See you in the next update! Thank you for the support!

notes.title: LxL PC Version Out Now — Let’s Celebrate!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

The wait is over—LxL PC version has officially launched on Steam! We couldn’t have reached this milestone without your patience, feedback, and unwavering support. Our team poured endless hours (and more than a few late-night coffees) into bringing this to life, and we’re beyond thrilled to finally share it with you.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
Dive In! Whether you’re in the PC version or jumping into the VR DLC, we can’t wait to see how you experience LxL’s world.
Share Your Thoughts! Got first impressions, epic screenshots, or just want to gush about your favorite new features? Hit us up on Discord or the Steam forums. We’re listening to every bit of feedback.
In the following days, we will also post a pseudo dev. road-map to highlight future changes, known issues etc.

[h1]LxL: Massive Update Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Animations, Characters[/h2]
[h3]Dozens of New Animations[/h3]
Experience smoother transitions, new idle poses, and brand-new action sequences.
[h3]Better Hair Physics & Mechanics[/h3]
Let those locks flow naturally, whether you’re standing still or in the heat of the moment.
[h3]New Fluid Systems
[/h3]Yes, we went there: dynamic wetness and cumshots for an even more realistic (and playful) experience.
[h3]New Orgasm System
[/h3]Characters now react more believably to your every move, adding spontaneity to those steamy encounters.

[h2]Customization & Props[/h2]
[h3]Upgraded Character Creator
[/h3]New body shapes, facial features, colors, and customization options. Make your characters truly one-of-a-kind.
[h3]Fresh Outfits & Accessories
[/h3]Stock up on sexy lingerie, role-play costumes, and more ways to dress up your favorite characters.
[h3]Pinata System (Game Economy)
[/h3]Earn or unlock a variety of props, toys, and outfits to keep the experience feeling fresh and rewarding.

[h2]New Camera & Cinematics
[/h2][h3]Photo Mode & Cinematic Mode[/h3]
Capture stunning screenshots or sit back and watch the action unfold like your own private movie. New filters and camera angles let you get that perfect shot or vantage point.
[h3]Screenshot Support
[/h3]Love what you see? Snap a pic to preserve the moment forever.

[h2]Environments & Scenes
[/h2][h3]Cabaret Scene (New!)[/h3]
Step into our swanky new venue—also home to the new tutorial—and explore a setting brimming with atmosphere.
[h3]More Detailed Existing Scenes[/h3]
We revisited every location, adding fresh assets, improved light maps, and richer details to make each space pop.

[h2]Movement & Controls[/h2]
[h3]Tweaked Movement Systems[/h3]
Enjoy more natural motion in VR with updated camera controls and improved controller mapping.
[h3]New AutoMode[/h3]
We gave the gameplay a serious makeover “AutoMode”, making it more intuitive and less fussy—perfect for a “hands-free” experience.

[h2]Engine & Performance[/h2]
[h3]Engine Upgrade[/h3]
We’ve fully shifted to an upgraded engine for smoother performance, improved visuals, and a more robust development base.
[h3]VR Optimizations[/h3]
Fine-tuned everything for existing VR headsets. Expect faster loading, fewer hiccups, and better responsiveness overall.
[h3]Drastically Reduced Load Times[/h3]
We’ve chipped away at loading screens so you can jump right into the action.
[h3]Quality Settings (AA & DLSS)[/h3]
We’ve added quality options like anti-aliasing and DLSS support for both VR and PC, giving you more control over graphics performance.

[h2]Story & Onboarding[/h2]
[h3]New Tutorial[/h3]
We’ve introduced a brand-new tutorial that covers both PC and VR basics, ensuring a smoother onboarding for everyone.

[h2]Immersion & Audio[/h2]
[h3]New Gestures (VR & PC)[/h3]
Interact with the world in more expressive ways—point, wave, or show a little sass.
[h3]New SFX & Voice Lines[/h3]
Ambient music? Check. Responsive moans and reactions? Double-check. We’ve added layers of audio goodness to heighten the mood.
[h3]Expanded Music Library[/h3]
Each scene now boasts fresh tracks to match the vibe, from slow and sultry to upbeat and playful.

[h2]UI & Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Tons of New UI Changes[/h3]
Cleaner menus, more intuitive icons, and a streamlined layout—less fussing around, more fun.
[h3]Over 200+ Bugs Squashed[/h3]
We stopped counting once we hit the 200 mark. Suffice it to say, the game is far less buggy and far more stable. (we probably made more as well)

[b]Thank You, Truly[/b]
We know this was a colossal overhaul, and it wouldn’t have been possible without your feedback and support. We’re not stopping here. This is just the beginning of our journey with LxL PC. 
Expect updates with new scenes and cosmetics, and plenty more surprises down the road. We’ve got big dreams, and we can’t wait to keep growing this game alongside you.
From all of us on the team, thank you again for believing in our vision and helping us make LxL a reality. Now go forth and enjoy everything we’ve created—we’ll be right here, cheering you on!

Happy gaming,
The LxL Team

notes.title: Huge Update & Overhaul: Here’s What’s Coming!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]
We’re beyond excited to share some major changes we’ve been working on behind the scenes. This overhaul is all about making your experience even more immersive, engaging, and (hopefully) unforgettable. Read on for a quick rundown—or feel free to jump straight to the features if that’s what you’re here for!

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]
We’re branching out from our VR roots and bringing our game to PC! 
And here’s some great news for our existing players: if you already own the VR version, the PC version will be added to your library automatically. 
It’s a huge step for us, and we can’t wait to welcome even more of you into our world—complete with all the twists you already know and love. We’re aiming to deliver the same heat, humor, and heart as before, plus a few surprises we think you’ll really enjoy.


[b]A Peek at Our Overhaul Plans[/b]
While we finalize the PC release, we’ve also been hard at work on a complete overhaul of some key features. Here’s a quick look:

[b]Parallel Paths for VR & PC
[/b]We’re developing the PC version alongside our existing VR experience, but with a sharper focus on user-friendliness and more content. It should be easier than ever to jump in and explore.

More Animations & Improved Models
We’ve added tons of new animations and enhanced character models to boost the overall look and feel. Expect richer details and a more polished experience all around.

[b]New Camera Modes                                                                                              
[/b]We’ve introduced a free camera option, a dedicated photo mode with filters, and a cinematic auto cam so you can capture the best moments or sit back and enjoy the scenery exactly how you want.

[b]Upgraded Character Creator & Outfit Variety
[/b]We’ve completely revamped our character creator, bringing in a wider range of outfit options and customization features. Now you can truly make the experience your own!

[b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b]
Get ready for a cleaner, more intuitive interface designed to make every action smoother.
Better Lighting Everywhere
We’ve improved the lighting system across the board, adding more depth and atmosphere to each scene.

[b]New Tutorial Level[/b]
To help you learn the updated gameplay mechanics (and get comfortable with PC controls), we’re rolling out a brand-new tutorial. This way, you can dive in without feeling lost.


As always, we can’t thank you enough for your feedback and support. We’re bringing the game to PC and can’t wait for you all to dive in!

notes.title: Celebrating Our First Year (and Our Next Big Step!)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/h2]

Our journey started with a love for VR and a determination to push its boundaries. Now, we’re ready to take the next big step: with high demand, yes, [b]we’re bringing our game to standalone PC![/b] We can’t wait to see how you’ll explore it in new ways, the team’s working hard behind the scenes to make sure the PC version delivers all the heart and soul we’ve poured into VR (plus a few surprises we’re itching to share).

It’s wild to think that an [b]entire year has already passed[/b] since we first hit “publish” on our dream project. Back then, it was just six of us huddled around a table, crossing our fingers that at least a handful of you would enjoy what we poured our hearts into. Fast-forward to today, and we’re blown away by how far we’ve come together. Your support, feedback, and incredible passion have shaped our world in ways we never imagined—thank you for being part of this crazy ride!

Speaking of surprises, we’ve got [b]something extra special[/b] up our sleeves to celebrate this anniversary—so keep your eyes peeled for upcoming announcements. We promise it’ll be worth the wait!

From all of us here on the LoveXLust Team, thank you for making this past year unforgettable. Every review, video, feedback, and heartfelt message has fueled us to reach for bigger and brighter goals. We literally couldn’t have done this without you. Here’s to another year of pleasures, laughs, and growth—together!

With gratitude,
LoveXLust Team
